items.title: 1 in 5 patients experiencing ‘awful’ A&E corridor care across the UK, new survey reveals
items.summary: 09/11/2026 - Thousands of A&E patients across the UK every day, including patients in mental health crisis and children, are being forced to receive care on chairs or trolleys, in waiting rooms or in corridors, according to a new survey conducted by the Royal College of Emergency Medicine (RCEM).

items.summary: A decline in district and community nursing roles has led to a rise in people at the end of life having to turn to A&E departments for help, the Royal College of Nursing (RCN) has warned. RCN general secretary and chief executive Professor Nicola Ranger said there were now ‘too few’ nurses in the community...
